rootAttributes.registers: deterministic block arguments then operation results; exact recomputation, no producer safe flag

semantics.allocation: alloc then explicit zero-result constructor call; no hidden root; object result is original alloc SSA
semantics.constructorAccess: facts4 requires constructor.access public; private/protected constructors remain unsupported; the private candidate descriptor is no formal Source identity or execution authorization
semantics.dispatch: virtual by actual class plus explicit override/projection edges; direct-base-method is distinct
semantics.initialization: own field initializers in source order before base body or after successful super; absent initializer remains uninitialized
semantics.literal: only direct scalar.literal.unresolved field initializers or direct RHS of field assignments with owned target kind number and exact context/origin/source-target/assignable initializerCompatibility or assignment compatibility resolve the original token through one exact f64 RNE rounding to 16 lowercase hex bits; field assignment evaluates receiver then RHS then write; finite overflow rejects; facts/HIR remain unresolved; all other literal contexts remain unsupported; no host rounding
semantics.locals: SSA definitions and rebinding; const does not freeze object
semantics.roots: fresh complete CFG fixed point; live-before reference operands include dead-after-call receiver/arguments; alloc result excluded before alloc; optimize invalidates analysis
semantics.views: same object; complete official target-to-source member projection; actual class and identity unchanged
semantics.wire9: all reference modules and zero-result constructors rejected before any packet output
